name: UltraToasty
summary: Your living room is ground zero for a robotic apocalypse! In UltraToasty, the mechanized "Legion" is invading your home, but you are a Time-Lord. Master this arcade action by bending time itself. Trigger epic slow-mo to dodge lasers by millimeters, line up impossible blaster shots, and slice through armor with your sword. Shoot, slash, and control time to defend your reality. Turn the Legion into scrap!
